name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2076: The control that decides whether the third eye runs sat 20th of 25 children inside ADVANCED, behind eight util buttons, four output panels, the repair box and the fleet list, in a rail 238 to 430px wide. It was never hidden by status - g5_status reports present, authorized, mode shadow, and refreshG5 polls every 20s. Moving it to first was necessary and NOT sufficient: measured with no scrollIntoView it still sat 609px into a 786px rail because the details element itself lives near the bottom. It now leads the panel under a real heading and opening ADVANCED brings it into view. Also: sc-card-tvd had no grid area so it auto-placed onto an implicit third row taking one of three columns - 589px of grid became 462px with no orphaned columns.
